key_insight: HECKTOR 2025 benchmarks multimodal PET/CT AI for three linked head-and-neck cancer tasks: tumor segmentation, recurrence-risk prediction, and HPV status classification.
clinical_relevance: If reliable, these models could support radiotherapy planning and earlier risk stratification in head and neck oncology workflows.
method: Expanded multi-institutional benchmark using PET/CT plus electronic health records
Three tasks: segment primary tumor and lymph nodes, predict recurrence-free survival, classify HPV status
Compared submitted algorithms on a held-out test set
evidence_signal: The challenge included over 1,100 patients from 10 centers, with 35 registered teams and 15 final submissions; top results reached Dice 0.75, c-index 0.66, and balanced accuracy 0.56.
watch_item: Performance was modest for prognosis and HPV classification, so external validation and careful clinical integration are still needed before deployment.
paper_title: HEad and neCK TumOR (HECKTOR) 2025: Benchmark of Segmentation, Diagnosis, and Prognosis in Multimodal PET/CT
